floater.name: wolf_builder
floater.title: Wolf Builder

check_box.name: builders_mode
check_box.label: Builders Mode
check_box.tool_tip: The same switch as the Build floater's Builders Mode: a Midday sky while the Build floater is open, and the grids below. Your own sky comes back when the Build floater closes or this is unticked.

check_box.name: grid_show
check_box.label: Show the grid on the ground while building
check_box.tool_tip: The snap grid, drawn on the ground around the selection (or around you) while Builders Mode is on and the Build floater or this window is open, not only while dragging. Its lines are every spacing step.

combo_box.name: grid_spacing
combo_box.tool_tip: The step between grid lines and snap points (the Build floater's GridResolution).

combo_box.name: grid_size
combo_box.tool_tip: How far the drawn grid reaches (the Build floater's GridDrawSize).

check_box.name: snap_origin
check_box.label: Snap and draw from my own grid origin
check_box.tool_tip: Off: the grid starts at the region's south-west corner, as the World grid always has. On: it starts at the point below, so a build that is not on a whole metre still snaps to itself.

floater.text: Origin, in metres from the corner of the region you are in

button.name: origin_from_selection
button.label: Set origin from the selection
button.tool_tip: The centre of what is selected becomes the grid origin. With nothing selected, where you are standing.

check_box.name: object_grid_show
check_box.label: Show grid on object
check_box.tool_tip: The grid on the selected object's own box, in the Build floater's ruler (World, Local or Reference grid), so you see it in relation to the object. Follows the selection; nothing when nothing is selected. Needs Builders Mode on.

button.name: object_grid_btn
button.label: Grid on object
button.tool_tip: Select an object first, then press this to show the grid on it.

check_box.name: object_grid_all_faces
check_box.label: On every face, not only the bottom
check_box.tool_tip: Grids on all six sides of the selection's box: yellow top and bottom, magenta front and back, cyan left and right (the colours of the Build floater's snap guides).

check_box.name: names_show
check_box.label: Float each object's name above it
check_box.tool_tip: Every object (never an avatar) within the radius shows its name above it, as hover text does. Off clears them all.

slider.name: names_radius
slider.label: Within
slider.tool_tip: Metres from you. Names appear as the region answers, nearest first, at most a hundred at a time.
